sentences.ar: بالصيف، توم وهَك قرروا يدوروا على كنز.
sentences.en: In the summer, Tom and Huck decided to hunt for treasure.

sentences.ar: راحوا على بيت قديم مهجور برا البلد.
sentences.en: They went to an old abandoned house outside the town.
They climbed to the upper floor and sat.
They heard a door opening below them.
Two men came in and sat talking.

sentences.ar: واحد منهم كان جو، بلبس تاني.
sentences.en: One of them was Joe, in different clothes.

sentences.ar: الولدين ما قدروا يتحركوا ولا يتنفسوا.
sentences.en: The two boys could not move or breathe.
